name: Newer College Dataset
summary: 牛津学院区域的手持多传感器序列，结合 LiDAR、视觉、IMU 与厘米级轨迹真值。
summaryEn: Handheld Oxford sequences combining LiDAR, vision, IMU, and centimeter-accurate trajectory ground truth.
scale: Nearly 6.7 km of recordings; stereo and multi-camera releases
scaleZh: 录制路线近 6.7 公里；包含双目及多相机版本
organizations: University of Oxford Dynamic Robot Systems Group
organizationsZh: 牛津大学动态机器人系统研究组
licenseZh: 数据集许可条款需进一步核查
access: Official project links to sequence downloads
accessZh: 官方项目提供序列下载入口
verdict: 真实多传感器运动序列
wmNote: 对齐传感器与真值轨迹支持运动条件观测预测和长距离空间一致性检查。
wmNoteEn: Aligned sensors and trajectories support motion-conditioned observations and long-range spatial consistency checks.

evidence.sourceTitle: Newer College Dataset | The Newer College Dataset revisits New College, Oxford with modern stereo camera and LIDAR sensors as well as precise ground truth.
evidence.statement: Hand-carried stereo/LiDAR/IMU recordings include challenging motion sequences and precise ground truth; static map alone is not the inclusion basis.
